results.parity: 344 passed (341 on main, +3 in tests/parity/nitrogen-narcosis.test.ts): legacy's drift stays at rest through narcosis-air-65m on the recordings' stubbed 0.5 draws, over more than 100 drift draws above index 0.45; every recording that holds a key (buoyancy-*, barotrauma-*) stays at index 0.3 or below, legacy's threshold written out, where no draw swallows a key; and the departure recorded in docs/decisions.md (#220, 2026-10-10): at every checkpoint of the three recordings that hold keys the kept keys are legacy's and only the draw count departs, 3 for legacy against 0. No recorded checkpoint is affected; the index comparisons are unchanged.
results.e2e: 192 passed in 8.8 min on the first run, no retries, no flake. No spec reaches index 0.3 with a key held long enough to change a shark roll on the pinned seed.
results.pixiVisualCheck: 3 scenes ok, 0% changed pixels, max delta 0, nothing re-recorded

rule: Owner decision on #220 (2026-10-07): swallowed inputs above index 0.3 and the vertical drift above 0.45 are ported, drawn from the dive's own seed (#219) so replays and resumes stay deterministic, with the drift saved like legacy's narcDrift. Tunnel vision and wobble follow in part 2; blur and grayscale are not ported.
change: src/core/narcosis-effects.ts holds legacy's perSecondToPerFrameProbability, swallowInputs (W, S, A, D drawn in that order, each only while held, and none at a drop chance of 0) and narcosisDriftStep ((rand - 0.5) * 0.3 * strength * dtReal, decayed by 0.98, 60 times it added to the velocity in m/min, 0 at index 0.45 or below, unchanged at the surface). DiveModel.swallowInputs() draws them from DiveState.randomState once per frame; advanceWithBuoyancy() takes the frame's real seconds and drifts after the physics, before the shark's rolls, as legacy's frame does. src/app/game-controller.ts asks the model for the kept keys before the frame moves the diver, moves along the route with the kept A and D, hands the kept W and S to the BCD, and turns the sprite only to the one fin key held, on a frame that kept it (Codex round 1). DiveState.narcosisDrift is saved: save version 17, v1-v16 saves resume it at 0, a current save must carry a finite one, and the legacy import maps narcDrift. The skipped draws at a drop chance of 0 are a departure recorded in docs/decisions.md.

counterChecks.method: Each mutation applied by a script to a file backed up beforehand, the named vitest files run, then the file restored from its backup and compared with filecmp (shallow=False): byte for byte identical in every case. On the first pass C7 (the held W and S) and P2 (keys dropped from 0.15) failed no test; 9623d03 added the BCD check and legacy's 0.3 written out, and both then fail. C3 and C9 were seen to be uncovered when the mutations were written, and fc36426 added their tests before the first pass.
